name: Hensel MiU_0100 enclosure base
summary: MiU_0100 enclosure base arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: MiU_0100 is the drawing identifier for enclosure base in Hensel's ENYMOD Mi enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An enclosure base forms the selected housing body. Its mounting interface, internal usable space and cable-entry faces must be coordinated with its separately selected lid and internal equipment.

For example, in a field junction box containing terminal rails, use the MiU_0100 reference to coordinate base fixing, selected cable-entry faces and internal mounting. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as MiU_0100.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep base fixing, selected cable-entry faces and internal mounting visible in the layout.
This reference concerns the named MiU_0100 drawing and its enclosure base role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
drawingChecklist: Match MiU_0100, the native drawing identity and the project equipment schedule.
Identify the matching lid, mounting parts and selected internal arrangement.
Coordinate base fixing, selected cable-entry faces and internal mounting with neighbouring equipment.
Confirm the current manufacturer installation instructions, selected revision and any required mounting or clearance details.
